nodes.name: aep_summary_kalpitiya_160m_fitted.json
nodes.summary: Machine-generated AEP summary for the Kalpitiya 160m fitted wind-resource case, recording capacity factor, gross/net AEP, turbine count, power-curve key, IEC standard, loss breakdown and provenance. Produced by analytics.wind.aep_summary_builder as a canonical resource input for downstream finance scenarios.

nodes.name: aep_summary_mullikulam.json
nodes.summary: Machine-generated AEP summary for the Mullikulam site (10 x Vestas V150-5.6MW, CF 0.2713, net 133.1 GWh) capturing power-curve key, IEC standard, loss breakdown and OEM provenance. Serves as a wind-resource input artifact for AEP-driven finance runs.

nodes.name: bad_missing_tax.yaml
nodes.summary: Intentionally malformed scenario used as a negative test fixture: a full DutchBay config whose tax block is incomplete/missing to exercise validation error paths. Drives schema and required-field checks in the config loader.

nodes.name: contracts_edgecase_base_v14.yaml
nodes.summary: Minimal v14-compliant base scenario (150MW wind, 25yr life) used as the foundation for contracts sensitivity edgecase tests. Provides a stripped-down project/fx/tax/debt/capex/opex/revenue baseline to layer edgecase overrides on.

nodes.name: dscr_sensitivity_example.yaml
nodes.summary: Example configuration demonstrating dual-DSCR debt-sizing sensitivity analysis for the lender case, showing how debt capacity varies with key project parameters. Consumed by analytics.dscr_sensitivity to produce lender-facing sensitivity output.

nodes.name: dutchbay_basecase_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Base-case 2025Q4 scenario for the 150MW DutchBay wind farm covering project, tax/statutory, returns, tariff, FX, capex/opex, financing terms, Monte-Carlo and sensitivity blocks. The central reference configuration for full-pipeline finance runs.

nodes.name: dutchbay_equitycase_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Equity-perspective 2025Q4 scenario for the DutchBay wind farm, mirroring the base case structure but tuned for equity-return analysis (returns, KPIs, financing, WACC). Used to evaluate sponsor IRR and NPV under the equity view.

nodes.name: dutchbay_lendercase_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Canonical lender-case 2025Q4 scenario (Sprint 17): full wind-resource, turbine, PPA, FX, capex/opex, financing covenants, Monte-Carlo, sensitivity and expected-results blocks for the 150MW DutchBay project. The most complete lender-facing configuration driving the full pipeline.

nodes.name: dutchbay_lendercase_5usc_fixed_lkr.yaml
nodes.summary: Tariff-and-cost variant of the canonical lender case: PPA benchmarked at 5.0 US cents/kWh paid in fixed LKR with a bottom-up granular CAPEX ($1,300/kW) and escalating OPEX. Demonstrates the deeply uneconomic outcome (project IRR 0.23%, equity IRR -6.33%) under realistic costs.

nodes.name: dutchbay_master_config_v14.yaml
nodes.summary: Master v14 configuration aggregating financing terms, capex/opex, constraints, FX, IRR validation, Monte-Carlo, named scenarios and sensitivity scenario definitions for the DutchBay model. Acts as the consolidated multi-scenario control file.

nodes.name: dutchbay_mc_enhanced_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Enhanced Monte-Carlo scenario (Sprint 17) modeling four correlated stochastic variables — revenue, operating costs, FX, and turbine degradation — for the DutchBay project. Consumed by the Hydra Monte-Carlo CLI to run correlated-uncertainty risk analysis.

nodes.name: dutchbay_optimistic_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Optimistic 2025Q4 sensitivity scenario for the DutchBay wind farm with favorable tariff, cost, FX and risk assumptions, including embedded scenario_result and IRR-validation blocks. Used as the upside bound in scenario comparisons.

nodes.name: dutchbay_pessimistic_2025Q4.yaml
nodes.summary: Pessimistic 2025Q4 sensitivity scenario for the DutchBay wind farm with adverse tariff, cost, FX and risk assumptions plus embedded scenario_result and IRR-validation blocks. Used as the downside bound in scenario comparisons.

nodes.name: dutchbay_sprint17_enhanced.yaml
nodes.summary: Sprint 17 enhanced scenario integrating turbine specs, wind_resource, finance, Monte-Carlo, debt_sizing and sensitivity blocks with explicit defaults import and output section. Represents the consolidated Sprint 17 end-to-end configuration.

nodes.name: edge_extreme_stress.yaml
nodes.summary: Extreme-stress edge scenario applying severe adverse parameter combinations across tariff, cost, FX, tax and risk blocks to stress-test the DutchBay model's robustness and constraint handling. Includes scenario_result and IRR-validation sections.

nodes.name: example_a.yaml
nodes.summary: Compact example scenario (Example A) with minimal project, tariff, FX, opex/capex, tax, risk and financing blocks. Serves as a lightweight demonstration/test input for the config loader and pipeline smoke checks.

nodes.name: example_a_old.yaml
nodes.summary: Legacy/superseded version of the Example A scenario kept for backward-compatibility and regression comparison against the current example_a.yaml. Same minimal project/tariff/fx/cost/financing structure.

nodes.name: example_b.json
nodes.summary: JSON-format example scenario (Example B) providing project, tariff, FX, opex/capex and financing-terms blocks. Demonstrates JSON config parsing parity with the YAML loader for the DutchBay model.

nodes.name: example_b.yaml
nodes.summary: YAML-format example scenario (Example B) with project, tariff, FX, opex/capex, tax, risk and financing blocks. Paired with example_b.json to demonstrate equivalent YAML/JSON configuration inputs.

nodes.name: example_fx_structured_blocks.yaml
nodes.summary: Reference scenario demonstrating the v14R6-compliant structured FX block format (replacing scalar FX values) alongside project, capex/opex, tariff, tax and debt blocks. Serves as the canonical example for the required structured-FX configuration.
